summary: Universal Health Services, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion on August 20, 2026 of a registered public offering of $600 million 5.500% senior secured notes due 2031 and $500 million 6.000% senior secured notes due 2036, $1.1 billion total. Notes are guaranteed on a senior secured basis by existing and future subsidiary guarantors, issued under the existing base indenture as supplemented by the Third Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee and JPMorgan Chase as collateral agent. Interest pays semi-annually each March 1 and September 1 from March 1, 2027. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing risk given first-lien collateral pledges.
